support.scope: One pinned English Amy-small 1.08M (English) voice checkpoint with the official piperlite WASM runtime
support.notes: The source package is the pinned official Amy-small FP16 piperlite package. A reproducible converter emits the matching FP32 browser front/decoder ABI; the pinned en-us phoneme config and voice slot 1 are retained. Output is 22,050 Hz. The bundled browser artifact is a reproducible benchmark conversion, not an upstream prebuilt browser voice package.

settings.callPattern: One official SanoTTS.synthesize call per canonical source span; no harness text splitting.
settings.assetOrigins: Explicit same-origin assetBase and voiceBase; cross-origin fetches and script loads are rejected.
settings.disposal: The official wrapper has no dispose method; the dedicated worker is terminated to release its WebAssembly modules.
